title: Text: DET Ben Fidelman ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: What's going on with the staff? Waiting until it's full to announce?
I’m told it’s pretty much filled out. Waiting to finalize administrative process then will announce all at once.
Ok
Possibly by end of week
Anyone coming back?
Believe the number will be two
Nice!
Got my money on Lloyd and Geno
Cora should have snatched Geno up, though
Or any of the first year guys, really
Have you read La Velle Neal’s story about coaching staff?
Just did
I knew Lloyd was coming back but I thought hitting coach
Who's hitting coach/first base
I was just wondering how you guys were going to announce. I should have asked Al but I don't really want to waste a bullet on it
His report about Lloyd is inaccurate. As is Woodbery’s tweet about Vavra.
Evan just tweeted, "per Lavelle." So Lavelle is wrong on both accounts?
Nevermind
No, La Velle didn’t say Vavra is going to be our bench coach... Evan did
Says "similar role"
Not going to confirm any positions to you but don’t want you to look like an idiot in two days with 3B coach and bench coach are not Lloyd and Vavra
That's fine...thank you
With Evan, just looks like a case of not reading close enough
With Lavelle it's kinda like why put the Lloyd stuff if you don't have it confirmed
Assuming Vavra gave him a bunch of shit and la velle didn’t confirm with anyone else
Slippery slope reporting like that
Yeah...thanks for the heads up
You could just tell me as a trust-building exercise
Sure I’ll give you one per day until we announce
Today’s is Bosio as pitching coach
Ok
Who is manager?
That’s tomorrow’s... can’t spoil it today
Will hit you with it at 12:01
Lol
Can you report Vavra as quality control coach?
The misinformation is spreading
On account of poor reading skills by best writers
Beat
Yeah
One sec
Is there going to be a "bench coach"?
Yes
To be named later this week
"A" quality control coach? Or "the" quality control coach
Is he the first quality control coach in team history?
The
Don’t have that information for you
Ok
What time do you go to print?
Gone, but I'll write something for web
Great
So is Rick Anderson bullpen coach?
Or do I have to wait until 12:01 a.m.
Vavra is best I can do for you tonight
Ok
Watching this movie called Lion
Recommend
Any insight on what quality control coach does?
Really don’t know. We asked today in passing and didn’t get a concrete answer back. Sorry that I don’t have more for you on it.
No prob
